From my heart

Things I Want to Say to You 💬

Dear Apeksha didi,

Thank you. Thank you for always being there — for every small moment and every big crisis. You never made me feel alone. That means more to me than you'll ever know. 🙏

I'm so proud of you. Watching you walk into Capgemini with your head held high — I felt my heart burst with pride. Papa and Maa feel the same way every single day.

The memories. From our childhood photos together, to Diwali rangoli nights, to card game sessions — every memory with you is something I treasure deeply. 💙

Always remember — no matter how far life takes us, I — Nikhil, your little brother — will always be your biggest fan. And so will Maa Kavita and Papa Dilip. We love you, Apeksha. 💖

— Your bhai Nikhil, with all his love 💌

The Puppalwar Story 🌟

MARCH 23, 2002

👧👦

Little Apeksha & Nikhil grew up together — two siblings who became each other's best friends forever. 💙

🪔

FESTIVALS & TRADITIONS

From Diwali rangoli to festival celebrations — she always brought grace, art and warmth to every occasion. 🌸

📚

SCHOOL & COLLEGE

She chose IT engineering and gave it everything. Maa Kavita and Papa Dilip watched with pride every day.

💼

CAPGEMINI

She walked into one of the world's top IT companies as a confident professional. So incredibly proud! 🏢✨

🌟

TODAY — AGE 23

Celebrating 23 wonderful years — loved by Dilip ji, Kavita ji, and Nikhil. The best is still ahead! 🚀💖

Always & forever

No matter what happens,
We'll always be there for you 💖

From Papa Dilip, Maa Kavita, and your little brother Nikhil — you are our heart, our pride, and our greatest joy. Thank you for being you. Happy Birthday, Apeksha Puppalwar. This is just the beginning. 🌟
